Terms & Conditions — CrazyPay P2P

1. Purpose of Background Alerts & Ledger Sync

CrazyPay requires continuous real-time transaction notification authorization to monitor incoming UPI and IMPS bank references. This automated service matches 12-digit UTR identifiers instantly with pending P2P orders to release crypto/INR escrow without manual intervention.

2. Platform Liability Disclaimer

CrazyPay app/platform bears no legal or financial liability in case of funds delayed, stuck, or failed due to third-party banking downtime, NPCI network delays, or incorrect UTR/account numbers submitted by users. Users are solely responsible for verifying transaction credentials.

3. Delayed or Stuck Transactions Support Guide

If any transaction is delayed or an order remains unreleased due to bank server congestion, do NOT raise duplicate disputes. Users must submit their valid payment screenshot and bank UTR statement directly to the official CrazyPay Telegram Support handle for expedited manual verification.

4. Authorization & Compliance

By ticking the agreement and allowing alerts, you consent to CrazyPay storing your device synchronization status locally for secure transaction processing.
